description: This file defines the NotesService class in an Angular application, which manages notes and categories data, including CRUD operations, data loading, and UI state management.

classes.name: NotesService
classes.description: Service managing notes and categories data, state, and API interactions.

methods.name: loadAll
methods.description: Loads notes and categories from the backend API.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with provided partial data.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by id.

methods.name: createCategory
methods.description: Creates a new category with the given name.

methods.name: renameCategory
methods.description: Renames a category identified by id.

methods.name: deleteCategory
methods.description: Deletes a category by id and unassigns notes assigned to it.

methods.name: selectNote
methods.description: Selects a note for editing by id.

methods.name: selectCategory
methods.description: Selects a category filter by id.

methods.name: setSearch
methods.description: Updates the search term for filtering notes.
